flow.name: REST API for sending reminder of resolve mantises

route1.js: message.env.email = message.content.email; message.content.resolvedIssues= message.content.issues ; message.content.resolvedTable = true;

route3.js: message.logsMsg = message.content; message.content = {}; message.content.html = message.logsMsg; delete message.logsMsg; message.content.title = `🔔 Some RESOLVED Mantises Needs to be CLOSE`; message.content.to = message.env.email;

route4.js: let result = message.content.rejected; message.content={}; if (!result.length) message.content.result = 'True'; else message.content.result ='false';
